About San Juan

San Juan blends 500 years of Spanish-colonial history with Caribbean beaches and salsa-filled nights — and as part of the US, no passport is needed for Americans.

Best time to visit San Juan

The sweet spot is generally Dec–Apr (peak); Apr–Jun value — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

Top things to do in San Juan

  • Wander the blue-cobblestone streets of Old San Juan
  • Tour the clifftop forts El Morro and Castillo San Cristobal
  • Relax on Condado and Isla Verde beaches
  • Kayak the bioluminescent bay in nearby Fajardo
  • Day-trip into El Yunque rainforest

Good to know

Generally safe. Language: Spanish, English. Visa for US passports: US territory — no passport for US citizens.
